name: Spirit Totem Staff (Draknara signature)
description: a tall carved wooden spirit-totem staff in one hand, planted upright, its shaft wrapped in strips of {{PRIMARY}} and {{ACCENT_SOFT}} cloth that hang and sway, woven leather cords, feathers, beads and small stone charms dangling from it, topped with a carved totem face encircled by a ring of feathers and a spiral sun-and-earth shaman symbol, a faint {{MAGIC}} glow in the totem's carved eyes
notes: Earth/Shaman signature item: reads as a shaman's totem, not a necromancer's skull staff.
